sponsored.t: Authorizes remote electronic witnessing performed with an electronic notarization, facilitates recording of electronically executed conveyances, and validates electronic signatures on certain documents; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permits electronic notarization and witnessing of certain documents.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations to 12/31/2031.

sponsored.t: Establishes the volunteer emergency medical services infrastructure and response equipment grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the volunteer emergency medical services infrastructure and response equipment grant program to support projects which sustain or enhance emergency medical services operations, infrastructure and equipment.

sponsored.t: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination
sponsored.sum: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination prior to inclusion on any bill or notice.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county.

sponsored.t: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community
sponsored.sum: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community for purposes of community preservation funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to host counties and host municipalities of commercial gaming facilities
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that host counties and host municipalities of commercial gaming facilities receive no reduction in appropriated aid after gaming facilities licensed under title two-A of article 13 of the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law have commenced gaming operations.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county.

sponsored.t: Reduces electric corporations' response time for securing downed wires
sponsored.sum: Requires each utility to take appropriate safety precautions regarding electrical hazards, including developing plans to promptly de-energize downed wires within two hours of notification of the location of such downed wires from a municipal emergency responder and promptly secure such wires within six hours in the case of events that are not considered emergencies.

sponsored.t: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers on renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs
sponsored.sum: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers regarding renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs through a variety of methods, including brochures, posters, social media, television ads, and public ambassadors.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of information on home care services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Department of Veterans' Services to consult and collaborate with relevant offices in the federal department of veterans affairs, the department of health, the state office for the aging and other HCBS experts to develop educational materials for veterans and their families about the accessibility to home and community-based services.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain reforms for ORES oversight of siting of major renewable energy facilities and major electric transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to transparency and other requirements for applications submitted to ORES for siting of major renewable energy and major electric transmission facilities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes seniors and persons who are severely disabled to use an ATV to enter and exit certain lands for ice fishing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes seniors and persons who are severely disabled to use an ATV to enter and exit certain lands where ice fishing is permitted by the department of environmental conservation when conditions are reasonably safe for the operation of ATV's.

sponsored.t: Relates to land used in agricultural production
sponsored.sum: Includes certain land that is owned or rented as a farm operation for the production for sale of crops, livestock or livestock products as land used in agricultural production.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state bridge authority to provide a report outlining their efforts and progress on decreasing and deterring suicide attempts on authority bridges
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state bridge authority to provide a report by July 1, 2027, outlining their efforts and progress on decreasing and deterring suicide attempts on authority bridges.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalty of knowingly violating the provisions relating to the appropriate shelter for dogs from a violation to a misdemeanor
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalty of knowingly violating the provisions relating to the appropriate shelter for dogs from a violation to a misdemeanor, punishable by imprisonment for not more than one year, or by a fine not less than five hundred dollars nor more than one thousand dollars, or by both.

sponsored.t: Allows certain unlicensed individuals to provide care to animals in the custody or possession of an animal shelter
sponsored.sum: Allows certain unlicensed individuals to provide care to animals in the custody or possession of an animal shelter under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers to disclose all available endorsements for homeowners liability insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to disclose all available endorsements for homeowners' liability insurance policies with plain language descriptions of the coverage added by each endorsement as part of the application process.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York rural growth fund tax credit and the New York rural growth fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York rural growth fund tax credit and the New York rural growth fund; provides that individuals who develop a business plan to invest in rural business in New York and have successfully solicited private investors to make capital contributions in support of such business plan may apply to the department of economic development for certification as a rural business growth fund; provides that if approved, tax credits shall be issued in an aggregate amount equal to seventy percent of the eligible investment authority; defines terms; provides for penalties; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Enacts the renewable natural gas standard act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "renewable natural gas standard act"; requires the public service commission to establish a program to require that gas corporations procure renewable natural gas from third-parties, including affiliates of the gas corporation, for distribution to natural gas customers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fractional pricing of certain petroleum products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fractional pricing of any motor fuel for use in internal combustion engines in motor vehicles or motorboats; imposes civil penalties of up to twenty-five dollars per day.

sponsored.t: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits
sponsored.sum: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of his deceased wife with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Enacts the planning approval predictability act
sponsored.sum: Requires the planning board or other administrative body of a town, village or city authorized to designate, review and approve, approve with modifications, or disapprove site plans to develop a standardized form containing all requirements for such site plan review applications; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes additional paid leave for public employees who are absent on military duty
sponsored.sum: Authorizes additional paid leave for public employees who are absent on military duty up to sixty days or fifty-two working days.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the importation, manufacture, sale, distribution and use of glue traps, glue boards, and other adhesive-based rodent traps.

sponsored.t: Provides for cost-of-living adjustments of disability benefits for an employee with a permanent total disability
sponsored.sum: Provides for cost-of-living adjustments of disability benefits for an employee with a permanent total disability to be based on an increase of the consumer price index as promulgated by the U.S. department of labor.

sponsored.t: Provides for statewide uniformity of vehicle inspection fees
sponsored.sum: Requires that maximum fees to be charged by an official inspection station are uniformly applicable statewide.

sponsored.t: Provides for low-cost power and energy services for providers of services for individuals with developmental and/or intellectual disabilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the power authority of the state of New York to make low-cost power and energy services available to providers of services for individuals with developmental and/or intellectual disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the disability care providers fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the disability care providers fund; provides for an election to such fund to be made on the personal income tax return of a taxpayer.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing the wasting of assets subject to a potential civil action by a crime victim
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of victim services to immediately take such actions as are necessary to avoid the wasting of the assets until the expiration of all applicable statutes of limitation for a crime victim to bring a civil action to recover money or damages from such assets.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grid modernization surcharge
sponsored.sum: Requires the public service commission establish a grid modernization surcharge imposed on utilities for the energy use of data centers and high-intensity data centers which meet a specified threshold of electricity or information-technology load; establishes the grid modernization fund to finance investments in system reliability, capacity expansion, and integration of clean energy resources.

sponsored.t: Provides that only products containing milk may use the term "milk product" on labels and advertisements
sponsored.sum: Provides that only products containing milk may use the term "milk product" on labels and advertisements; defines "milk product".

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program to make findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing bail and pre-trial detention for arson felonies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail and pre-trial detention for all arson felonies.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail for certain offenses involving threats of mass harm against a school district, school, school staff or a student
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of bail for certain offenses involving threats of mass harm against a school district, school, school staff or a student.

sponsored.t: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail for certain offenses involving the sale or possession with intent to sell of a controlled substance or a synthetic opioid
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of bail for certain offenses involving the sale or possession with intent to sell of a controlled substance or a synthetic opioid.

sponsored.t: Provides exceptions to the three-year prohibition of employment with the New York state gaming commission
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides exceptions to the three-year prohibition of employment with the New York state gaming commission; excludes starters from the three-year prohibition; allows the commission to provide exceptions during the hiring process.

sponsored.t: Creates licenses for roadside farm markets to sell beer, cider, and liquor
sponsored.sum: Creates licenses for roadside farm markets to sell beer, cider, and liquor.

sponsored.t: Permits sports wagering on New York college teams
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Removes the prohibition on sports wagering on sports events involving New York college teams.

sponsored.t: Provides for transportation after 4pm by school districts in Sullivan county
sponsored.sum: Requires transportation after 4pm be provided for certain students by school districts in Sullivan county.

sponsored.t: Provides for a real property tax exemption for property owned by certain limited liability companies
sponsored.sum: Provides for a real property tax exemption for property owned by single-member limited liability companies where such property serves as the primary residence of such member.

sponsored.t: Provides for mental health counseling for correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision, in consultation with the commissioner of mental health, to make mental health counseling available to all correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the fair market value of labor rates for services covered under motor vehicle insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services, in consultation with the department of transportation to conduct a study and prepare a report on the fair market value of labor rates for services covered under motor vehicle insurance policies.

sponsored.t: Provides for the employment of school nurses for the inspection of pupils attending certain public schools
sponsored.sum: Provides for the employment of school nurses for the inspection of pupils attending certain public schools; relates to school districts and boards of cooperative educational services.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Roland The Gator Ward
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Sullivan county to Lieutenant Roland "The Gator" Ward.

sponsored.t: Requires the establishment of hybrid heating pilot programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of hybrid heating pilot programs to further the goals of the climate leadership and community protection act (CLCPA).

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Bloomingburg to enter into a contract to sell or pledge as collateral for a loan some or all of the delinquent liens held by such city to a private party or engage a private party
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Bloomingburg to enter into a contract to sell or pledge as collateral for a loan some or all of the delinquent liens held by such city to a private party or engage a private party.

sponsored.t: Relates to metropolitan commuter transportation district registration fee exemptions for farm vehicles
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that farm vehicles pay the metropolitan commuter transportation district (MCTD) supplemental registration fee.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to make failure to move over a five point violation
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to make failure to move over a five point violation.

sponsored.t: Prohibits operation of any motor vehicle equipped with any device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of any motor vehicle equipped with a device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals; provides that the possession of such a device shall constitute a traffic infraction, use thereof is a class A misdemeanor, and use which results in personal injury or death shall constitute a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to reports of substantial risk or threat of harm by mental health professionals
sponsored.sum: Exempts police and peace officers receiving treatment from mandatory reporting of substantial risk or threat of harm by mental health professionals, unless the mental health professional determines, based on reasonable professional judgment, that the condition impairs such person's ability to perform their job duties.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county.

sponsored.sum: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises.

sponsored.sum: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises.

sponsored.t: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the town of Wallkill to adopt a hotel or motel tax of up to 5%
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for the town of Wallkill to adopt a hotel or motel tax of up to 5%.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage hickory shad
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage hickory shad.

sponsored.t: Authorizes additional paid leave for public employees who are absent on military duty
sponsored.sum: Authorizes additional paid leave for public employees who are absent on military duty up to sixty days or fifty-two working days.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections relating to adult residential health care applicants
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections relating to adult residential health care applicants.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for prenatal vitamins
sponsored.sum: Relates to coverage for prenatal vitamins and related insurance coverages.
